categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Easton Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. operates primarily in pharmaceutical manufacturing, focusing on chemical raw materials, high-end chemical drugs, and biopharmaceuticals. The company emphasizes R&D, production, and sales across the full industry chain, with key therapeutic areas including anesthesia and analgesia, cardiovascular, oncology, and endocrine diseases. It also engages in CMO/CDMO services and technology transfer.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed six core technology platforms: drug crystal form innovation and industrialization, innovative drug molecular design and evaluation, controlled-release and delayed-release technologies, nasal spray formulation technology, manufacturing process design and lean control, and mRNA raw material synthesis technology. It employs advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing standards including GMP and cGMP, and integrates digital and intelligent manufacturing to enhance production efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals, medical institutions, pharmaceutical distributors, and international pharmaceutical companies. The company serves domestic markets extensively across various Chinese regions and exports to international markets including the US, Europe, Japan, and countries along the Belt and Road. Its products target patients with cancer pain, cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, and other chronic conditions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Chengdu and subsidiaries in multiple Chinese cities. It has expanded its international footprint with product registrations and sales in the United States, Europe, Japan, Russia, and several Belt and Road countries. Domestic sales cover all major regions including Southwest, East, North, South, Central, Northeast, and Northwest China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu Easton Biopharmaceuticals operates across the pharmaceutical supply chain, including upstream chemical raw material production, midstream drug formulation and manufacturing, and downstream sales and distribution. It also provides contract manufacturing and development services (CMO/CDMO), positioning itself as an integrated pharmaceutical manufacturer and service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven growth with over 20% of revenue invested in R&D, focusing on anesthesia and analgesia, cardiovascular, oncology, and endocrine therapeutic areas. It advances small molecule innovative drugs, biopharmaceuticals, and improved formulations, accelerating international registration and commercialization. Digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and lean production are key strategic initiatives to enhance efficiency and competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of chemical formulations and raw materials, contract manufacturing and development services (CMO/CDMO), and technology transfer and licensing. The company uses both direct sales and distribution channels domestically and internationally, with a significant portion of sales through distributors and some direct sales to pharmaceutical manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in anesthesia and analgesia in China, with multiple first-to-market and nationally recognized products. It competes with other high-end generic and innovative pharmaceutical companies domestically and faces international competition in global markets. Its integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities, along with a strong product pipeline, provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.35 billion, a 20.82% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 238 million, up 5.15%. R&D investment accounted for over 21% of revenue. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by new product launches and expanded market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chengdu Easton Biopharmaceuticals emphasizes high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical products with strong clinical value, focusing on unmet medical needs in anesthesia, cardiovascular, oncology, and endocrine diseases. It differentiates through proprietary technology platforms, integrated raw material and formulation production, and compliance with international standards. The company also highlights its robust R&D pipeline, rapid product iteration, and international market expansion as key competitive differentiators.
